scene_description: A first-person traversal through an apartment entry hall, coat closet, laundry closet, kitchen, and living area. The user sequentially opens and closes two coat-closet leaves, two laundry-closet leaves, a refrigerator, an upper spice cabinet, and a utensil drawer.
